description: Capture a technical decision in a durable ADR document covering context, options considered, the decision, and its consequences. Use when someone says "document this decision", "why did we choose X over Y", "record the reasoning behind this", "write up why we did this", or asks for an ADR, decision record, or design rationale after a choice has been made -- most users will not say "ADR" outright. Best used after plan-change: plan-change decides what to do before code is written, draft-adr records why, once the decision is settled, for future maintainers.
